﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229EF
Height-independent subpolynomial primitive SPACE hypotenuse fibers by genus-five / Gaussian 2-descent / DGH


STATUS=PROVED_FIXED_PRIMITIVE_SPACE_HYPOTENUSE_ABSOLUTE_d_EPS_INDEPENDENT_OF_B / PROVED_SUMMED_SPACE_LOW_d_M_1_PLUS_EPS / EXISTING_174_SMALL_SPACE_SECTOR_DEDUPED / QMIN_MEDIAN_SUPPORT_COUNT_OPEN / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0
CARD_DOC_ID=1-s0-szKTptHJdrL4idvjKq3D-7dtHY9TNIyw3I6rJog
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA=Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229EE
OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY=M3-T11-229; LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION=M3-T11-228; M3-T11-230 NOT_ISSUED.
PRIMARY_GATE=M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN; GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0; P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false; RESEARCH_PRODUCTION_STATUS=HOLD_PENDING_SELECTOR_AWARE_OR_SUPPORT_LEVEL_THEOREM_INPUT.
INDEPENDENT_HOSTILE_AUDIT_229EF=NOT_RUN.


1. LIGHTWEIGHT AUTHORITY, ANTI-LOOP, AND CRITICAL PREVIOUS RESULT


MAIN current override, INDEX row600, LEDGER current and ROUTE current all point to229EE. 229EE uses229ED genus-five fixed FACE primitive Pythagorean hypotenuse to cover all THREE face orientations at Oeps(M^(1+eps)); its high full-selector residual has all three primitive face hypotenuses >B^(1/3-sigma). The physical source is positive primitive (e,x,y,U,V,z,R) with U²=e²+x²,V²=e²+y²,z²=x²+y²,R²=e²+x²+y², gcd(e,x,y)=1, R<=B, full original chamber/229DP high sf(G0), high Kcross/rad(Sd), exact q/Gres/K-null selectors. No unproved uniform endpoint count is inferred.


IMPORTANT ANTI-LOOP FINDING: OLD M3-T11-161 (INDEX row390) already proved the THREE short primitive face-slope sector <=M with count M B^o(1), so neither229ED nor229EE should be advertised as FIRST-EVER power saving on that already-covered sector; their quantitative B-INDEPENDENT Oeps(M^(1+eps)) bound, if accepted, is the stronger aspect. OLD M3-T11-174 (INDEX row403, full card ID 1_ic-h_X9wS8EZwpNflXzGZEDPEKg2qCAgHveaOwLyeE) already proved for D_i=R/gcd(R,e_i) and D_min=min_i D_i: fixed D_min=d has B^o(1) full physical endpoint fiber, summed D_min<=Z is Z B^o(1), and at fixed q_min median-content sum yields sqrt(B/q) B^o(1). Thus merely adding THREE short SPACE hypotenuse sectors repeats old174 and is NOT novel. We instead prove a stronger DIFFERENT height-independent bound at FIXED d, not a new B-exponent low sector. Original 229DT-A1 negative disallows multiplying face/space probabilities. 229EE attempted direct divisor summation failed with B^(1+o), not reattempted. M3-T11-174's genus-one fixed-height proof does not give B-independent finite total point count: genus-one carrier can have infinitely many rational points. This card uses new genus-five three-square physical lift to replace B^o by d^o.


2. NEW THEOREM 229EF.1: FIXED PRIMITIVE SPACE TRIANGLE HAS GENUS-FIVE CARRIER


Select the space-right triangle U²+y²=R² and its EXACT primitive content k=gcd(U,y)=gcd(R,y). Let
 U=kp, y=kq, R=kr,    p²+q²=r², gcd(p,q)=1, p,q,r>0.
Since k|U and k|y and U²=e²+x², if a prime divided both k and e, it would also divide x, contradicting gcd(e,x,y)=1. Hence gcd(k,e)=1.
Put t=e/k (a rational number in lowest terms with denominator EXACTLY k). The other THREE rational square constraints become
 u²=p²-t²                 [u=x/k],
 v²=q²+t²                 [v=V/k],
 w²=r²-t²                 [w=z/k].                              (229EF.1)
Define C^space_{p,q}: u²=p²-t², v²=q²+t², w²=r²-t². Over Qbar(t) the three quadratic polynomials have SIX pairwise distinct simple branch roots t=±p, ±i q, ±r. Since 0<p<r and q>0, all distinct, and three square-root classes independent. The connected (Z/2)^3 degree-eight cover has Riemann-Hurwitz 2g-2=8(-2)+6*4=8, thus g=5. It is smooth after normalization and geometrically irreducible. It has rational t=0 with (u,v,w)=(p,q,r). This point itself has e=0 and is NOT a positive physical endpoint.
Every original positive primitive point on this fixed oriented primitive space triple injects into C^space_{p,q}(Q): recover k as the reduced DENOMINATOR of t=e/k; e=numerator, y=kq,U=kp,R=kr, x=ku,V=kv,z=kw with positive signs. Thus there is NO free scaling variable once t is known, even as B tends to infinity. In particular the NUMBER OF ALL possible such physical points, WITHOUT any R cutoff, is <=#C^space_{p,q}(Q). It is not claimed any nonzero rational t physical point exists.


3. GENUS-FIVE FIVE-ELLIPTIC JACOBIAN SPLITTING AND UNIFORM RANK


Write f1(t)=p²-t², f2(t)=q²+t², f3(t)=r²-t² and s=t².
As in retained229EB for general three even quadratic squarecovers with disjoint branch sets, Jac(C^space_{p,q}) is Q-isogenous to FIVE genus-one elliptic factors:
 (i) three pair-product quartics E_ij: h²=f_i(t)f_j(t), i<j, each with rational t=0 points, and
 (ii) E4: h²=(p²-s)(q²+s)(r²-s),
 (iii) E5: h²=s(p²-s)(q²+s)(r²-s).
The genus-two intermediate h²=f1(t)f2(t)f3(t) has two elliptic quotients E4,E5; the three E_ij dimensions plus genus-two dimensions sum to genus5 and the character-space maps give the Q-isogeny. No assumption of rank<5 is made.
Put K=Q(i) and D=2pqr(r²+q²), a nonzero integer with 0<D<=4r^5. For each pair E_ij, four ramification points on its quartic are among {±p,±i q,±r}, hence all K-rational; choosing a ramification point as origin gives complete K-rational 2-torsion. E4 and E5 also have complete Q-rational 2-torsion, from the rational roots s=p²,-q²,r² and s=0,p²,-q²,r² respectively. Their discriminant supports lie ONLY at primes dividing 2pq r(r²+q²): the squared-root differences are p²+q²=r², r²-p²=q², and r²+q², plus the branch roots and powers of 2. Thus all five elliptic curves have good reduction over K away from primes above 2D (integral models may be minimized). The 2-Selmer Kummer map embeds Sel_2(E/K) in K(S,2)^2, where S is primes above 2D. Z[i] is a PID, #S<=2omega(D)+O(1), so
 rank E(K) <=dim Sel_2(E/K)<=4omega(D)+O(1).
Ranks are Q-isogeny invariant; rank Jac(C^space_{p,q})(Q)<=20omega(D)+O(1).                    (229EF.2)
Since D<=4r^5, omega(D)=O(log(2r)/loglog(3r)), proving rank Jac = O(log(2r)/loglog(3r)), uniform across all primitive space triangles. The implied constants are absolute.


Dimitrov-Gao-Habegger Theorem 1.1, Annals Math 194 (2021), DOI 10.4007/annals.2021.194.1.4, author copy https://ziyangjeremygao.github.io/articles/UnifML.pdf, states #C(Q)<=c(5,1)^(1+rank Jac(C)(Q)), with absolute c independent of coefficient height. Therefore
 #C^space_{p,q}(Q) <= exp(O(log(2r)/loglog(3r)))=r^o(1).                              (229EF.3)
For each fixed epsilon>0, there is a single C_epsilon such that EVERY primitive (p,q,r) satisfies #C^space_{p,q}(Q)<=C_epsilon r^epsilon. No B enters.


4. THEOREM 229EF.2: FIXED LABELED PRIMITIVE SPACE HYPOTENUSE ABSOLUTE d-EPS FIBER


A positive integer d is hypotenuse of O_epsilon(d^epsilon) primitive ordered integer Pythagorean triangles; indeed Euclid's m²+n²=d and r_2(d)<=4tau(d), and tau(d)=d^o(1). For fixed d and chosen ordered space direction, combine this representation count with (229EF.3), distributing epsilon/2 each:
 #{P original positive primitive (ANY R): R/gcd(U,y)=d} <= C_epsilon d^epsilon.         (229EF.4)
The same bound applies by edge permutation to
 D_y=R/gcd(U,y)=R/gcd(R,y),
 D_x=R/gcd(V,x)=R/gcd(R,x),
 D_e=R/gcd(z,e)=R/gcd(R,e).
The space triangle (z,e,R) uses t=x/k and leads to the identical f_i pattern. Every such injection is on the original positive primitive source BEFORE the asymmetric chamber/G0 selector, so adding selectors only shrinks counts. Thus, UNIFORMLY IN EVERY B,
 #{P full physical positive primitive R<=B : min(D_e,D_x,D_y)=d}<=C_epsilon d^epsilon,    (229EF.5)
by a finite 3-direction union (a point can have several attaining d; harmless). Consequently
 #{P:R<=B,min(D_e,D_x,D_y)<=M} <=C_epsilon M^(1+epsilon), for M>=2 and ALL B.          (229EF.6)
This strengthens old174's Z B^o(1) to a B-INDEPENDENT bound with only M dependency. It does NOT establish a new numerical power-saved B-sector beyond old174: with M=B^(1/3-sigma), the exponent 1/3-sigma/2 was already attainable qualitatively via Z B^o(1), although here the constant is absolute for a fixed M.


Combine with the B-independent fixed-FACE theorem229EE: all 6 primitive face/space triangle hypotenuses can be retained as a union of low labels with Oeps(M^(1+eps)) original positive primitive R<=B population. Define
 F1=V/gcd(e,y), F2=U/gcd(e,x), F3=z/gcd(x,y),
 D1=R/gcd(R,e), D2=R/gcd(R,x), D3=R/gcd(R,y).
Let H_B^EF,six(delta,sigma) be original high229DP physical selector set with ALL six F1,F2,F3,D1,D2,D3 > B^(1/3-sigma).
Then original Stage37 receiver can be written
 #S_B(delta) <= B^(1/3)exp(-Lambda)+O_sigma(B^(1/3-sigma/2))+#H_B^EF,six(delta,sigma).  (229EF.7)
The six-high residual is an exact subset of the previous229EE three-face-high residual, but the space-low portion was ALREADY disposed by M3-T11-174, so count that once only. No new global o(B^(1/3)) proof or counting credit is assigned.


5. ACTUALLY TESTED ALTERNATIVE / SPECIFIC REMAINING OBSTRUCTION


M3-T11-174 fixed q_min=q fiber had additional moving median content h_b, with D_min=q*h_b and h_b<=sqrt(B/q); it proved m_q(B)<=sqrt(B/q) B^o(1). Insert the NEW absolute bound (229EF.5) into exactly the same median parameter:
 m_q(B)<=sum_{1<=h_b<=sqrt(B/q)} C_epsilon(q h_b)^epsilon
       <= C_epsilon B^((1+epsilon)/2) q^((epsilon-1)/2).                     (229EF.8)
For small epsilon, still ~sqrt(B/q) B^o and summing q<=Q yields at best B^(1/2+o)Q^(1/2+o), not o(B^(1/3)). Thus the stronger fiber theorem DOES NOT solve the occupied median-content support problem. It would require a theorem that only o(B^(1/3)) actual (q,h_b) labels are occupied after all original full selectors, NOT a generic bound for all h_b in the interval. This alternative was actually evaluated, not declared impossible.


Another attempted shortcut, interpreting the six low-label events as independent probabilities, is INVALID: all six arise from the SAME physical solution, and prior229DT-A1 excludes unproved independent products. No such product is used.


6. QUALIFICATION, CREDIT, NEXT


Substantive new mathematical result: for FIXED primitive space-diagonal Pythagorean hypotenuse d, the TOTAL number of primitive full-four-square positive integer endpoints over ALL heights is O_epsilon(d^epsilon), independent of B (equations229EF.4-.5). This is stronger than old174's B^o height-dependent bound, and uses a different genus5+uniform DGH route. It is NOT a claim that a positive perfect cuboid exists, NOT a new 1/3-threshold sector first discovered here, and NOT a global endpoint count. The existing229ED/EE B-independent fixed-face contribution is retained, while duplication with old161 is now explicitly flagged.


NEXT_PRIMARY=For six-high H_B^EF,six, a genuinely physical selector-aware occupied-support theorem of the moving median-content (q_min,h_b) or same-x (Gres,K-null) dyadic count, rather than any further fixed-face/space-primitive-hypotenuse deletion. In medium e<=B^1/2 with q_Uz q_Vz<B^(1/6+eta), retain sf(Gres)>B^(1/6-delta-eta). For e>B^1/2 test229AR whole-G0 W-=UV-eR, alongside original Kcross and rad(Sd), R cutoff and six-high flags. 229BF requires both229CY deficits; no formal route switch. Any future upgrade needs independent hostile audit.

﻿Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229EE
Three-face cyclic uniform cover and exact primitive-face G0 splitting on the original selector-high physical source


STATUS=PROVED_THREE_ORIENTATION_MOVING_LOW_SLOPE_POWER_SAVING / PROVED_EXACT_A_H_Q_FOUR_BUCKET_G0_SPLIT / TESTED_DIVISOR_LARGE_SLOPE_NO_POWER_SAVING / TRIPLE_HIGH_REMAINDER_OPEN / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0
CARD_DOC_ID=1a1P1DSrmvUT_j-do5j_Bg3Q1srX6uKkHyvcX_3serNo
PREVIOUS_POST_229_DELTA=Stage37-NEW-INPUT-DELTA-AUDIT-229ED
OPERATIONAL_AUTHORITY=M3-T11-229; LATEST_MATHEMATICAL_CONSTRUCTION=M3-T11-228; M3-T11-230 NOT_ISSUED.
PRIMARY_GATE=M3-T11-GATE-001 OPEN; GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0; P_OVER_M3_LIMIT_PROVED=false; RESEARCH_PRODUCTION_STATUS=HOLD_PENDING_SELECTOR_AWARE_OR_SUPPORT_LEVEL_THEOREM_INPUT.
INDEPENDENT_HOSTILE_AUDIT_229EE=NOT_RUN.


1. STARTUP AND RESEARCH/LOOP AUDIT


The authoritative current heads MAIN/INDEX row599/LEDGER/ROUTE all pointed to 229ED (card 1Vc7NU_MdM1OrhX5ND5BE2a7JsUdpF04ocrXNVvM0ti4). The goal remains original exact positive primitive P=(e,x,y,U,V,z,R), e²+x²=U²,e²+y²=V²,x²+y²=z²,e²+x²+y²=R², R<=B with chamber and all high229DP filters, sf(G0)>B^(1/3-delta) where G0=gcd(eR,xy). The still-open residual from229ED had only the ONE condition V/gcd(e,y)>B^(1/3-sigma). Relevant rows595-599 and NEGATIVE-REGISTER229DT-A1/229ED were checked; direct INDEX scans for 'three face', 'G0/a', 'gcd(ER,Yx)' returned no matching later result. Earlier229M four contents (edge pairgcds a,b and space-triangle c12,c21) and229DS full q_Uz/q_Vz valuations examined; these are prior distinct facts, not new credit. 229EB fixed inner genus5, 229EC generic positive E4 rank,229ED uniform DGH+Gaussian Selmer bound are retained. External DGH Annals 194(2021) source independently checked for genus/rank uniformity; the quantitative dependence c^(1+rank) is the 229ED load-bearing hypothesis, not newly proved here.


2. THEOREM 229EE.1 — CYCLIC THREE-FACE ORIGINAL PHYSICAL COUNT


Define the three primitive Pythagorean face HYPOTENUSES:
 T_ey:=V/gcd(e,y),  T_ex:=U/gcd(e,x),  T_xy:=z/gcd(x,y).
Each quotient is a positive integer, and its two divided face legs are coprime. For every M>=2 and epsilon>0, on the FULL positive primitive all-four-square source WITHOUT applying any chamber or Stage37 high selector, 
 # {P:R<=B, min(T_ey,T_ex,T_xy)<=M} <= 3 C_epsilon M^(1+epsilon)                  (229EE.1)
uniformly in B. Proof: 229ED for one fixed face pair bounds physical points with primitive normalized face legs max<=M by O_epsilon(M^(1+epsilon)), and the very same proof (genus5 three radical lifts, five elliptic factors, Q(i) 2-Selmer, uniform DGH) works for any of the 3 permutations of the edge labels. If primitive hypotenuse T<=M then each normalized leg <=T<=M. The map from original tuple to permuted tuple is injective and preserves all four squares, positivity, primitive gcd and R cutoff. It may NOT preserve the chosen chamber or the asymmetrical G0 high selector, but we count the larger unrestricted physical set BEFORE those restrictions, then intersect back with the original high source; no selector independence or orientation invariance is presumed. Summing the three disjoint-or-overlapping original-point subsets by the union bound gives (229EE.1). This is an ACTUAL physical count, not merely a conductor threshold.


For any 0<sigma<1/3 put M(B)=B^(1/3-sigma), epsilon=sigma/[2(1/3-sigma)]. Then
 # {P in H_B^DP(delta):min(T_ey,T_ex,T_xy)<=B^(1/3-sigma)}
      =O_sigma(B^(1/3-sigma/2))=o(B^(1/3)).                              (229EE.2)
This counts TWO ADDITIONAL previously unremoved slices of the 229ED large-inner-slope residual, namely T_ey>M but T_ex<=M OR T_xy<=M. For sigma=1/12, M=B^1/4 and the disposed union is O(B^(7/24)). The only surviving high set is
 H_B^EE,tri(delta,sigma):={P in H_B^DP(delta): T_ey,T_ex,T_xy>B^(1/3-sigma)}.  (229EE.3)
This is a STRICTLY MORE RESTRICTIVE DEFINITION than229ED H_B^ED,large; no claim that the actual difference contains a known perfect cuboid or has positive population.


The verified receiver becomes
 #S_B(delta)<=B^(1/3)exp(-Lambda)+O_sigma(B^(1/3-sigma/2))+#H_B^EE,tri(delta,sigma). (229EE.4)
All prior229DZ/EA physical low-R deductions may be applied only once. The residual triple-high #H is still OPEN, and GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT remains 0.


3. THEOREM 229EE.2 — EXACT FACE-PRIMITIVE MACRO-CONTENT SPLIT


Return to the SPECIFIC fixed original (e,y) face, let a=gcd(e,y), E=e/a,Y=y/a,W=V/a with gcd(E,Y)=1 and E²+Y²=W². Primitivity gcd(e,x,y)=1 implies gcd(a,x)=1. Since R²=x²+a²W², gcd(a,R)=1. Likewise gcd(a,U)=gcd(a,z)=1 by U²=x²+a²E²,z²=x²+a²Y².


Define H=gcd(ER,Yx). Then from e=aE,y=aY,
 G0=gcd(eR,xy)=a*gcd(ER,Yx)=aH.                                 (229EE.5)
In fact gcd(a,H)=1: if p|a and p|H, as p∤R,x we require p|E and p|Y, contradicting gcd(E,Y)=1. Hence squarefree support factors EXACTLY:
 sf(G0)=rad(a)*rad(H), gcd(a,H)=1.                              (229EE.6)


Use retained229DS full odd q conductor q_Uz and q_Vz. For p|q_Uz the exact original all-square valuation identity says v_p(q_Uz)=min(v_p(e),v_p(y))=v_p(a), so q_Uz|a and gcd(q_Uz,a/q_Uz)=1 (q_Uz odd). For p|q_Vz, retained229DS v_p(q_Vz)=min(v_p(e),v_p(x))=v_p(G0), while gcd(a,x)=1, so q_Vz|H and gcd(q_Vz,H/q_Vz)=1. Also q_Uz and q_Vz are coprime. Set a0=a/q_Uz,H0=H/q_Vz. Then
 G0=q_Uz * a0 * q_Vz * H0,
 gcd of every pair of these FOUR positive factors =1,              (229EE.7)
 G_res=G0/(q_Uz q_Vz)=a0*H0, gcd(a0,H0)=1.                      (229EE.8)
This is a same-physical, EXACT crosswalk between NEW primitive face-slope height W and existing229DS q/Gres packets. 229DS already proved G0=q_Uz q_Vz Gres, but not this face-normalized assignment of Gres to a0 and H0. It is not a new independent sieve filter; q_Uz and q_Vz are already charged once.


Since aW=V<=R<=B, a<=B/W. Therefore on the original high selector sf(G0)>B^(1/3-delta),
 sf(H)> B^(1/3-delta)/a >= W B^(-2/3-delta).                 (229EE.9)
For W>B^(2/3+delta+theta), theta>0, this gives sf(H)>B^theta. On an additional q_Vz<=B^kappa band, sf(H0)>B^(theta-kappa) if theta>kappa. These are exact necessary support implications but DO NOT themselves count endpoints and are NOT a replacement for H_B^EE,tri=o(B^(1/3)). In particular W>B^(1/3-sigma) alone gives no positive radical exponent from (229EE.9).


4. DIFFERENT METHOD EXECUTED AND REJECTED QUANTITATIVELY


Tested a direct large-W divisor-fiber count, not a loop restart. For fixed a,E,Y, (U-z)(U+z)=a²(E²-Y²) !=0, so the number of U,z positive solutions, and hence of actual physical x,R, is at most tau(a²|E²-Y²|). For R<=B, aW=V<=B. At fixed a, primitive Pyth face slopes with W<=B/a are O(B/a), from Euclid parametrization. tau(a²|E²-Y²|)<=B^o(1) uniformly (aE,aY<=B). Summing a<=B/M over slopes W>M gives at best B^(1+o(1)) after a harmonic sum. This is WORSE than retained229C absolute #X_phys(B)<<B^(1/2+epsilon), so no quantitative credit. This explicitly tests a distinct potential route and rejects its insufficient exponent without claiming global impossibility.


5. NEXT, STATUS, AND EVIDENCE BOUNDARY


Result difference:229ED counted one moving primitive face only;229EE removes the union of ALL THREE low-normalized-face orientations on EXACT original physical four-square source and cuts the remaining previously large (e,y) region to simultaneous triple-high. Additionally (229EE.5)-(229EE.8) supplies exact four coprime G0 factor assignment separating a's q_Uz and residual a0 from H's q_Vz and H0. Neither alone resolves the full original Stage37 final target. Most useful NEXT is a theorem on TRIPLE-high H_B^EE,tri, not reprove the three-face union: quantify occupied selector-aware dyadic (W,a0,H0,q_Uz,q_Vz), Gres/K-null/high Kcross/rad(Sd) with actual R<=B. Medium e<=B^1/2 q<B^(1/6+eta) & sf(Gres)>B^(1/6-delta-eta) survives; complementary e>B^1/2 retain 229AR W_-=UV-eR. Exploit the structural constraint that all three primitive face hypotenuses are >B^(1/3-sigma). Do not count raw modular fibers or multiply correlated factors. 229BF secondary only if BOTH229CY deficits. No formally audited route switch.

2. EXTERNAL THEOREM, PRECISELY APPLIED

For all smooth geometrically connected genus5 curves C/Q, there exists an ABSOLUTE c=c(5,1)>=1 (independent of coefficients, heights and individual C) such that
 #C(Q) <= c^(1+rank Jac(C)(Q)).               (229ED.1)
This is unconditional, no rank<g assumption, no conjecture. It is a point-count theorem, not a height bound; the constant may be ineffective.


3. UNIFORM RANK BOUND THROUGH K=Q(i)


Set D=2 E Y W |E²-Y²|. This is a positive nonzero integer because E,Y>0,E!=Y,W²=E²+Y². Put K=Q(i), class number one; primes over rational factors of D number at most 2 omega(D). We prove every one of the FIVE elliptic quotient factors (over Q) has rank over K at most O(1+omega(D)), with an absolute uniform constant.


(i) The pair quotients Eij: h²=(t²+m²)(t²+n²), m,n distinct in {E,Y,W}. Over K, the four branch points t=+/-i m,+/-i n are K-rational. Choosing a K-rational branch point as origin on the smooth genus-one model yields full rational 2-torsion over K: the four ramification points are precisely its four 2-torsion points. (ii) The E4 quotient has Weierstrass model T²=X(X-E²)(X-Y²), with rational full 2-torsion; discriminant 16 E^4 Y^4 (E²-Y²)² and good reduction away from D.
(iii) E5 has genus-one quartic k²=s(s+E²)(s+Y²)(s+W²), four distinct Q-rational branch points 0,-E²,-Y²,-W²; with (0,0) as origin these are the complete rational 2-torsion. The quartic branch discriminant only involves 2, E,Y,W and E²-Y², hence good reduction away from D.

 rank Jac(C_{E,Y})(Q) <=20 omega(D)+O(1).    (229ED.2)

There are O(M) ordered integer m,n pairs and only O(M) primitive ordered face slopes (E,Y,W) in this range.  #{P in X_phys(B):max(e/gcd(e,y),y/gcd(e,y))<=M} <= C_epsilon M^(1+epsilon) for ALL B>=1 and M>=2.   (229ED.4)
Same exact bound holds for every subset satisfying original high229DP masks. This is a genuine UNIFORM moving-slope physical population theorem; unlike Faltings fixed-M O_M(1), the constant is independent of M and B. It may be non-effective but is rigorous.

The coefficient in O_sigma is independent of B. For example sigma=1/12 gives M=B^1/4, choose epsilon=1/6 and count O(B^(7/24)) (below 1/3). No physical mask has been removed or multiplied; we upper-bound a whole original exact physical sector by a larger full curve point set.

Fixed primitive face slope e:y -> genus-five (Z/2)^3 fiber with FIVE elliptic Jacobian factors; uniform B-independent count for BOUNDED face slopes; fixed U-z direct attempt audited
STATUS=PROVED_SCOPED_BOUNDED_SLOPE_FINITE_PHYSICAL_POPULATION / PROVED_EXACT_GENUS5_FIVE_ELLIPTIC_ISOGENY / NOT_UNIFORM_MOVING_SLOPE / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0

1. Exact current target and focused anti-loop audit
Work only on the positive primitive original Stage37 full-four-square physical seven-tuples
P=(e,x,y,U,V,z,R), e²+x²=U², e²+y²=V², x²+y²=z², e²+x²+y²=R², gcd(e,x,y)=1, original chamber and all selectors, R<=B. High original H_B^DP(delta) has sf(G0)>B^(1/3-delta), moving high Kcross/high rad(Sd), and all exact masks; each upper bound below is an upper bound on this source by restriction.
Latest current authority229EA asks FIRST to test a fixed nonzero signed difference d=U-z or V-z, without assuming B^o fixed-d fibers, and if that fails test a different actual method. Scanned latest INDEX rows592-596, historic M3-T11-206 row435 (DIFFERENT signed space-triangle gap),229BF row523 (TWO-QUARTIC genus-five family with a fixed OUTER primitive (E,Z,H) and genus-1,1,3 quotients),229AB row493 (Faltings on bounded CM-dependent slopes, DIFFERENT subsource),229BR/229BT fixed LENGTH/RADICAL fibers,229AP/229DT K-null signs, NEGATIVE-REGISTER229DT-A1 sections 7/8. No fixed U-z full-physical uniform fiber lemma was found in these relevant records. DO NOT identify the result below with 229BF's outer-slope genus-five proof or treat that prior existence as a new genus-five theorem. Our NEW varying-object contrast is an INNER primitive FACE SLOPE (e/a,y/a) with three quadratic square lifts and 5 elliptic factors, and an actual fixed-slope B-independent population bound.


2. METHOD A TESTED: exact fixed signed gap quartic but no uniform B^o occupancy theorem
Let d=U-z be a fixed nonzero integer. It is nonzero on the original physical source, because U=z implies e²=y² and then V²=2e², impossible for positive integer V/e. For a physical point we have
    e²-y²=(U-z)(U+z)=d(2z+d).
Thus
    U=(e²-y²+d²)/(2d), z=(e²-y²-d²)/(2d).
Using x²=z²-y², an EXACT identity follows:
    4d² x²
       = [e²-(y+d)²][e²-(y-d)²]
       = [(e-y)²-d²][(e+y)²-d²].       (229EB.1)
All integrality, positivity, x²+y²=z², e²+x²=U², V²=e²+y² and R²=e²+z² must STILL be imposed. This is a quartic diophantine surface in moving e,y for each d; it is NOT an O(B^o) fixed-d physical fiber theorem. With y/e ratio also fixed, the RHS is a genus-one quartic in the scale; but its coefficients move with the ratio, and neither point counts nor heights can be uniformly summed. No false inference from Siegel/Faltings to a uniform bound. This candidate is therefore NOT promoted; research continued using a DIFFERENT parameter as required.
(M3-T11-206's fixed “space triangle” gap is a different quantity and cannot be used for d.)


3. THEOREM 229EB.2 — exact primitive face-slope to a genus-five rational curve
Put a=gcd(e,y) and (E,Y,W)=(e/a,y/a,V/a). From e²+y²=V², V/a is necessarily an integer (because a²|V²) and
    E²+Y²=W², gcd(E,Y)=1, E,Y,W>0.
In particular E !=Y, since 2E²=W² has no positive integral solution. Primitive gcd(e,x,y)=1 implies gcd(a,x)=1.
For this FIXED primitive Pythagorean pair (E,Y) with W²=E²+Y², define the affine curve over Q:
    C_{E,Y}:
       u²=t²+E²,
       v²=t²+Y²,
       w²=t²+W².                           (229EB.2)
Every original primitive physical P with (e/a,y/a)=(E,Y) determines
    t=x/a>0, u=U/a>0, v=z/a>0, w=R/a>0
and hence a rational C_{E,Y}-point. Conversely, a rational C_{E,Y}-point with t>0 and u,v,w>0 gives a unique positive primitive four-square tuple (e,x,y,U,V,z,R) before applying additional Stage37 selectors: write t=r/s in lowest positive terms, put a=s, x=r, e=sE, y=sY, V=sW and U=su,z=sv,R=sw. Since (su)²=r²+s²E² is an integer and su is rational, su is an INTEGER (a rational square root of an integer is integral). The same applies to z and R. Finally gcd(e,x,y)=gcd(s,r)=1 because gcd(E,Y)=1. This is an INJECTIVE height-preserving physical reconstruction: imposing R<=B and original selectors selects a subset of rational points, not a larger ambient endpoint measure.
The function field is Q(t)(sqrt(t²+E²),sqrt(t²+Y²),sqrt(t²+W²)). The three squareclasses are independent over Q(t), since the six zeros ±iE,±iY,±iW are pairwise distinct: each has odd valuation at a zero not shared by the other two. Thus the associated smooth projective connected curve has degree-eight Galois map C->P¹_t with group (Z/2)^3. Exactly six finite branch points have ramification index2, each with four preimages; infinity is unramified because each radicand has an even-order pole. Riemann–Hurwitz:
    2g(C)-2 = 8(-2)+6*4 = 8,
so g(C)=5. The curve is smooth on its normalization, geometrically connected, and has at least eight rational boundary points t=0 with u=±E,v=±Y,w=±W. These t=0 points are NOT positive physical endpoints.
By Faltings' theorem, C_{E,Y}(Q) is FINITE for EACH FIXED primitive face slope (E,Y). Through the exact injective reconstruction, there are only FINITELY MANY primitive positive physical Stage37 endpoints of ANY height sharing that fixed slope, even before the high selector filters. This is a mathematically rigorous but NON-EFFECTIVE finiteness theorem for the fixed slope.


4. THEOREM 229EB.3 — FIVE rational elliptic factors, different from retained229BF (1,1,3)
Write A=E², D=Y² and C=A+D=W². Consider the three quadratic radicands f1=t²+A, f2=t²+D, f3=t²+C.
The abelian-cover character decomposition of Jac(C_{E,Y}) over Q, via norm/pullback idempotents and finite-degree isogenies, separates the seven nontrivial character double covers. The three single-radicand covers have genus0, the three pairwise covers
    E_{ij}: h²=(t²+a_i)(t²+a_j)    (i<j in {1,2,3})
have genus1 (four distinct finite branch points), and the triple-product quotient
    H: h²=(t²+A)(t²+D)(t²+C)
has genus2 (six distinct finite branch points).
Consequently
    Jac(C_{E,Y}) ~_Q E_12 x E_13 x E_23 x Jac(H),
where the three genus-one curves have rational basepoints t=0,h=E*Y or E*W or Y*W and so may be treated as elliptic curves over Q. The genus-two H has two commuting independent involution quotients under t->-t and (t,h)->(-t,-h). In variables s=t², these give
    E4: h²=(s+A)(s+D)(s+C)                 (cubic genus1),
    E5: k²=s(s+A)(s+D)(s+C), k=t*h         (quartic genus1).
E4 has rational point s=0,h=EYW; E5 has s=0,k=0. Standard independent degree-two quotient/norm maps yield Jac(H)~_Q E4 x E5. Combining:
    Jac(C_{E,Y}) ~_Q E_12 x E_13 x E_23 x E4 x E5.     (229EB.3)
This is a FIVE-ELLIPTIC factorization over Q of the FIXED primitive face-slope genus-five curve. It is structurally DISTINCT from the previously logged229BF genus-five (Z/2)^2 cover with genus (1,1,3) quotient decomposition; no one asserts that the entire Stage37 source is one fixed such curve. An illustrative fixed primitive face is (E,Y,W)=(3,4,5), for which A=9,D=16,C=25 and E4: h²=(s+9)(s+16)(s+25), E5: k²=s(s+9)(s+16)(s+25). Nothing asserts a positive full endpoint on it.


5. ACTUAL SCOPED GLOBAL POPULATION RESULT AND QUANTITATIVE LIMIT
For each FIXED real M>=1 let
    C_B^slope(M)={P in X_phys(B): max(e/gcd(e,y),y/gcd(e,y))<=M}.
There are finitely many integral primitive Pythagorean pairs E,Y with E,Y<=M; for each, theorem229EB.2 gives finitely many rational t and at most one original primitive full physical tuple per positive t. Thus there is some finite C_M (independent of B) with
    #C_B^slope(M)<=C_M for EVERY B.
In particular # (H_B^DP(delta) intersect C_B^slope(M))=O_M(1)=o(B^(1/3)) for fixed M.
